purpose: Quality assurance: how well glycaemic control is achieved in our own patient population.
question: Among the patients of Klinikum Süd who have type 2 diabetes, how many in each age group have a latest HbA1c above 8 %, and what is that as a share of those who were measured?
definitions: Only patients whose record is held by Klinikum Süd are included.
Type 2 diabetes = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E11.
Use the latest HbA1c (LOINC 4548-4) per patient. Patients who were never measured are not part of the share.
For each age group: patients with type 2 diabetes, how many of them have an HbA1c measurement, how many have a latest HbA1c above 8.0 and that as a share of the measured patients in %, one decimal.
